common_evidence_boundary: The retained 2026 rule texts document current exchange-level terms, not historical effective-session terms across the 2019--2025 diagnostic period.
Neither rule page confirms individual account eligibility, short permission, broker fees, margin add-ons, limit-locks, fill, tax, capacity, delivery access or a net result.
Futures contracts are not equity claims. This diligence does not generate target prices, enterprise valuations, expected returns or a holding recommendation.
required_before_any_future_paper_action: Current exchange-adjusted calendar, contract status and delivery boundary.
Dated broker route confirmation for product access, long/short permission, margin, fees and forced-close procedures without adding personal records to the case.
Contemporaneous bid/ask, depth, limit status and a no-fill/partial-fill record.
Independent reconciliation of actual-contract selection, roll and settlement records.
